annotations.title: utilpeek: sign or verify an HMAC (webhook signatures)

description: utilpeek: Sign or verify an HMAC, including GitHub, Stripe and Slack webhook signatures. For plain digests use hash_text; for JWTs use verify_jwt. Returns the HMAC of a message under a shared key (sign), or whether a signature matches it in constant time (verify); handles GitHub (`sha256=` prefix accepted), Stripe `v1` (of `{t}.{raw body}`) and Slack `v0` (of `v0:{timestamp}:{raw body}`) webhook signatures. Input: `mode`, `message`, `key`, optional `key_encoding`, `algorithm`, `output` and, for verify, `signature`. Malformed hex or base64, a `sha*=` prefix naming another algorithm, or verify without a signature is a 422 (not charged). Other prefixes (`v0=`, `v1=`) are not stripped. sha1 is for legacy webhooks only. The key and message are never echoed. Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/verify-webhook-signature-hmac-api.html

algorithm.description: sha256 (default), sha512, or sha1 (legacy webhooks only).
algorithm.title: Algorithm

key.description: The shared secret (at most 1 KiB), read as `key_encoding`. Never echoed or logged.
key.title: Key

message.description: The signed payload exactly as received (e.g. the raw webhook body), as text; at most 64 KiB as UTF-8.
message.title: Message

signature.description: verify only: the signature to check, in `output` encoding. A `sha256=` style prefix (GitHub's X-Hub-Signature-256) is stripped when it names `algorithm`.
signature.title: Signature

name: hmac_sign_verify

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
